description:
Observed daily precipitation from NOAA NCEI GHCN-Daily at one of six selected Florida airport stations, not archived forecasts. Required station, start and end (YYYY-MM-DD); completed dates only, 1900 onward, at most 366 inclusive days per request. Public, no API key. Returns daily values in inches, original flags, coverage, monthly summaries and totals. totalIn is null for incomplete coverage; partialTotalIn is only the sum of accepted reported values. Trace is not dry. Presumed-zero, incomplete-period and quality-flagged reports are excluded. Reporting dates are station climate days, not UTC hours. A station does not measure rainfall at a nearby beach, inlet or across a region. Recent records may lag or be revised.
Use for how much precipitation fell: NOAA observed station records, not forecast archives. Preserve station, reporting dates, trace days, missing/excluded counts and coverage. Never present partialTotalIn as a complete monthly/yearly total. Station rainfall is not an area-wide measurement. Use get_rain for future amounts and get_history source=forecast:om_weather_best var=precip_in only for archived model estimates.
Units: ft, kt, s, F, mi; directions FROM. Returns data and source/freshness metadata.

station.description: USW00012844 = West Palm Beach airport; USW00012839 = Miami International Airport; USW00012836 = Key West International Airport; USW00012842 = Tampa International Airport; USW00012815 = Orlando International Airport; USW00013899 = Pensacola airport
